stemReviewers.subject: General Math
stemReviewers.title: Functions, Rational Equations & Inverses
stemReviewers.summary: Domain, range, rational functions, asymptotes, and inverse function properties.

blocks.text: A rational function is defined as a fraction of polynomials $f(x) = \frac{P(x)}{Q(x)}$ where $Q(x) \neq 0$.

blocks.title: Standard Rational Form
blocks.note: Compare degree n and degree m to find horizontal asymptotes.

items: Vertical Asymptote: Values of x where denominator Q(x) = 0.
Horizontal Asymptote: If n < m, y = 0. If n = m, y = \frac{a_n}{b_m}.

stemReviewers.subject: Physics
stemReviewers.title: Kinematics in 1D & 2D (Projectile Motion)
stemReviewers.summary: Uniform acceleration equations, trajectory formulas, and vector decomposition.

blocks.text: For uniform accelerated linear motion along a straight axis:

blocks.title: Torricelli Equation
blocks.note: Relates velocity and displacement without time.

items: Horizontal velocity is strictly uniform: $v_x = v_0\cos\theta$
Vertical velocity is accelerated by gravity $g = 9.8\text{ m/s}^2$: $v_y = v_0\sin\theta - gt$

blocks.title: Maximum Range
blocks.note: Max range occurs at angle theta = 45 degrees.

stemReviewers.subject: Finite Math
stemReviewers.title: Conic Sections & Standard Forms
stemReviewers.summary: Equations, vertices, foci, directrix, and eccentricity of circles, parabolas, ellipses, and hyperbolas.

blocks.title: Standard Form
blocks.note: Center at (h, k) with radius r.

items: Vertical axis: $(x - h)^2 = 4p(y - k)$, Focus $(h, k + p)$
Horizontal axis: $(y - k)^2 = 4p(x - h)$, Focus $(h + p, k)$

blocks.title: Standard Equation
blocks.note: c^2 = a^2 - b^2, foci at (h +- c, k).

quizSets.subject: Finite Math
quizSets.title: Conic Sections & Analytical Geometry Drill
quizSets.desc: Practice circles, parabolas, ellipses, hyperbolas, and foci coordinates.

questions.prompt: What is the radius and center of the circle with standard equation $(x - 3)^2 + (y + 5)^2 = 49$?
questions.explanation: The standard circle equation is $(x - h)^2 + (y - k)^2 = r^2$. Comparing values: $h = 3$, $k = -5$, and $r = \sqrt{49} = 7$.

questions.prompt:
Find the foci of the hyperbola:
$$ \frac{(x - 2)^2}{16} - \frac{(y + 1)^2}{9} = 1 $$
questions.explanation: For a horizontal hyperbola, $c^2 = a^2 + b^2$. Here $a^2 = 16$ and $b^2 = 9$, so $c^2 = 25 \implies c = 5$. The foci are $(h \pm c, k) = (2 \pm 5, -1)$.

questions.prompt: A horizontal parabola has equation $(y - 2)^2 = 16(x + 1)$. What is the focal distance parameter $p$?
questions.explanation: The standard form is $(y - k)^2 = 4p(x - h)$. Matching $4p = 16 \implies p = 4$.
For horizontal hyperbolas centered at $(h,k)$, slopes are +- b/a.
